name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
cues: Kneel on the knee of your pressing side, other foot flat in front
Hold the end of the bar at your shoulder
Press up and forward until your arm is straight
Keep your hips square and your glutes tight

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Right (pressing) knee is on the mat with toes tucked and the left foot flat in front, as cue 1 says. Only the right arm moves (the left hangs still) and the pelvis is fixed. Hand goes from 8 cm below and 22 cm ahead of the shoulder to lockout at 41 deg above horizontal, elbow 166 deg. Baked frames are monotonic and the loop closes. The figure-side sheet shows lockout at t=0.625 while the baked bottom lasts to about f77, so that sheet is a render artifact, not the motion. DOF jerk is at 89% of the gate.
